name: MobileProfile
css: .mobile-profile-page{min-height:100vh;background:#f5f7fa;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.top-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:56px;padding:0 16px;background:#ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f5;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}.nav-left,.nav-right{width:40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.nav-back,.nav-icon{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity 0.2s}.nav-back:hover,.nav-icon:hover{opacity:0.7}.nav-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#1A365D;margin:0}.main-content{flex:1;padding:16px;overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:80px}.user-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;color:#ffffff;margin-bottom:20px}.user-avatar{width:80px;height:80px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px}.user-info{text-align:center}.user-name{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 4px}.user-role{font-size:14px;opacity:0.8;margin:0 0 20px}.user-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.stat-item{text-align:center}.stat-item .stat-value{display:block;font-size:22px;font-weight:700}.stat-item .stat-label{display:block;font-size:12px;opacity:0.8;margin-top:4px}.data-section{margin-bottom:20px}.section-header{margin-bottom:16px}.section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0}.data-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}.data-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:20px 16px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04);cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}.data-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(26,54,95,0.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}.data-value{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;color:#1a2b5f}.data-label{font-size:13px;color:#8899aa}.menu-section{margin-bottom:20px}.menu-list{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04);overflow:hidden}.menu-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f5;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s ease}.menu-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}.menu-item:hover{background:#f8f9fc}.menu-icon{width:36px;height:36px;background:#f5f7fa;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.menu-name{flex:1;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#1a2b5f}.logout-section{margin-top:20px}.logout-btn{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #ffccc7;border-radius:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#c41e3a;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s ease}.logout-btn:hover{background:#fff2f0}.bottom-tab-bar{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:60px;background:#ffffff;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid #f0f2f5;padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0);z-index:100}.tab-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:1;height:100%;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s}.tab-item.active{color:#1A365D}.tab-item:not(.active){color:#a0a4b8}.tab-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;margin-top:2px}@media(max-width:375px){.user-card{padding:20px 16px}.user-avatar{width:64px;height:64px}.user-name{font-size:20px}.stat-item .stat-value{font-size:20px}.data-card{padding:16px 12px}.data-value{font-size:20px}}
